title: Cofiltered affine etale model
statement: Let I be a small nonempty cofiltered category, D:I→Scheme a diagram with compact quasi-separated stages and affine transition maps, c a cone whose underlying scheme cone is limiting, and U an affine etale object over c.pt. There exist i∈I, an affine etale V over D(i), and r:U→V such that the square (r,U.hom,V.hom,c.π_i) is a pullback.

source.place: Affine etale site descent, together with Tag 01ZM; reindex a cofiltered category by a directed poset.

proof.text: Apply IsFiltered.exists_directed to I opposite, use the left-opposite initial functor to preserve the limiting cone, inherit compactness, quasi-separatedness and affine transition properties, then use affineEtale_common_models on the singleton family U.

proof_origin.place: Proof and comparison calculations formalized by E1; complete argument in the declaration docstring.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_affineEtale_model_of_cofiltered
    {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsCofiltered I]
    (D : I ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    [∀ i : I, CompactSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ i : I, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ {i j : I} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (U : c.pt.Etale) [IsAffine U.left] :
    ∃ (i : I) (V : (D.obj i).Etale) (_ : IsAffine V.left)
      (r : U.left ⟶ V.left), IsPullback r U.hom V.hom (c.π.app i)
